sentences.text: For the Petitioner : Mr. Anuj Kumar Priti , Adv.
For the State : Mr. Tarun Kumar , Addl. PP 04 / 18.08.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending her arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Doranda P.S. Case No.37 of 2018 (G.R. No. 1241 of 2018) registered under Section 420/467/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner has earlier been rejected vide order dated 25.10.2021 in ABA No. 7974 of 2021 but the fresh ground is that the petitioner went to the court to surrender but the court of learned JMFC, Ranchi in which,
Doranda P.S. Case No.37 of 2018 corresponding to G.R. No. 1241 of 2018 is pending and informed the court that he is an accused of this Doranda P.S. Case No.37 of 2018 corresponding to G.R. No.
1241 of 2018 but the court did not take him into custody and told him to go.
The Investigating officer met him and recorded his statement but did not arrest him, hence, the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, be that as it may, if the contention of the petitioner is treated to be true, then this is a clear cut case that there is absolutely, no apprehension of the petitioner of being arrested in connection with any non-bailable offence, as neither the court concerned is ready to take him into custody, even though the petitioner informed that he is an accused of the case nor the I.O. of the case, is arresting him and only recording his statement as the witness of the case, hence this court is of the considered view that since there is no apprehension of the petitioner of being arrested in any non-bailable offence, the anticipatory bail is Asha Orain vs The State Of Jharkhand ...
